events.title: Portabellows will be in this October Next Fest!
events.summary: 🎮Play our demo for a taste: figure out how to bake your very first pie 🥧, explore every corner to discover yummy ingredients, abilities and plane pieces!Our Demo is up here, we did a few updates thanks to your feedback!Looking forward to even more feedback from Next Fest which will directly improve our full game! Progress is going amazing as we're tweaking the full experience and having fun along the way.🎉Enjoy the fest! I hope you find gems that are fully your jam!~ Nance and Phred 💖

events.title: Release date update : A short but needed delay
events.summary: Hi everybody, We made the decision to move our release date to the 20th of January 2027. We’re sorry we won't be able to make our original November 12th date, we were really excited to release it then!We’ve been debating pushing the date for a while and decided that prioritizing health and a good launch is better than sticking with our original date. events.title: Demo Patch Notes 1.0.2
events.summary: Summary: This patch focuses on introducing the story of the demo, reducing motion sickness, adding more charm, improving using the map, and making sure you get the right quality setup automatically, specially when it comes to the Steam deck!⚠️Save progress warning ⚠️: if you had already placed the pie disk on the altar, you'll have to restart your save to bake the pie.
